_status: Which column of the firm's Clio export holds what, for tools/import_clio.py. EVERY column name below is an assumption: Clio's own help pages for exporting matters and contacts refused the request (HTTP 403) on 10/03/2026, so no column list was read, and the one third-party page that mentions Clio's exports lists none. The names come from Clio's API objects (what a matter or a contact is called there), which is not proof of a spreadsheet's headings. Each field lists the names to look for, in order; a heading matches when it is the same name ignoring capitals, spaces, underscores and hyphens. The firm edits this file after opening its own export: put the real heading first. Each section's _basis says, field by field, where a name comes from. The importer's report says which headings it found and which it did not. TO CONFIRM WITH THE FIRM'S EXPORT.

_sources.says: Refused the request (HTTP 403): not read. A search result's summary says matters export from the Matters page as CSV, with all columns or only the visible ones, and that the export covers every matter the filters match.
Refused the request (HTTP 403): not read. A search result's summary says contacts export from the Contacts page as CSV or PDF.

Third party (a competitor's help page). Clio exports matters, contacts, calendar, tasks, notes, unbilled time and expenses, outstanding balances and trust balances, mostly as "Excel Ready CSV"; remove every filter first. Lists no columns and says nothing of documents.

API (JSON, not a spreadsheet): matter id, display_number, description, status (open, pending, closed), practice_area, responsible_attorney, client; contact id, name, first_name, last_name, primary_email_address, primary_phone_number, custom field values.

contacts._note: One row per person. All names below: to confirm with the firm's export.

_basis.id: guess: Clio's API has a contact id; no page read says a spreadsheet carries it
_basis.first_name: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): the contact's first_name; the spreadsheet's heading is not documented
_basis.middle_name: guess: no page read names a middle name column
_basis.last_name: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): the contact's last_name; the spreadsheet's heading is not documented
_basis.full_name: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): the contact's name; the spreadsheet's heading is not documented
_basis.email: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): primary_email_address; the other spellings are guesses
_basis.phone: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): primary_phone_number; the other spellings are guesses
_basis.language: guess: Clio has no language field of its own; a firm may keep one as a custom field
_basis.email_ok: guess: no page read names a consent column or field
_basis.sms_ok: guess: no page read names a consent column or field
_basis.whatsapp_ok: guess: no page read names a consent column or field
_basis.office: guess: no page read names an office column or field

matters._note: One row per matter. A matter's id is its Clio id when the export has one, else its matter number: a case made from a number is not the case a later connection to Clio makes from the Clio id, so prefer an export that has the id. All names below: to confirm with the firm's export.

_basis.id: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): the matter's id, then display_number; the spreadsheet's heading is not documented
_basis.number: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): display_number; the spreadsheet's heading is not documented
_basis.title: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): the matter's description; the spreadsheet's heading is not documented
_basis.client_id: guess: the spreadsheet may not carry the client contact's id
_basis.client_name: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): the matter's client; the spreadsheet's heading is not documented
_basis.type: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): the matter's practice_area (its name is what says a VAWA, T, U or asylum matter); the spreadsheet's heading is not documented
_basis.status: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): the matter's status (open, pending, closed); the spreadsheet's heading is not documented
_basis.archived: Clio API (https://docs.developers.clio.com/openapi.json): a matter whose status is closed is taken as archived (archived_yes below holds closed); the spreadsheet's heading is not documented
_basis.office: guess: no page read names an office column or field
